verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LibreChat ships Skills, a searchable tool library, Agent discovery and MCP connectivity, but nothing about the size or health of a community ecosystem. There is no evidence of thousands of published skills, plugins or presets, or of active community maintainers. The ability to connect to external MCP servers draws on a different ecosystem and is not LibreChat's own community catalog.

support.subject: As a power user, the community ecosystem is genuinely alive — thousands of published skills, plugins, or presets with active maintainers
